Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer made an error by initially misidentifying the film as "Happy Death Day 2U" instead of the correct 2017 film "Happy Death Day". This error led to incorrect information being provided from the start, when confirming that the 2017 Christopher B. Landon directed American slasher film starring Jessica Rothe was indeed "Happy Death Day". This misidentification hindered the problem-solving process, leading to repeated attempts to retrieve the correct information which was initially available from reliable sources like IMDb and Wikipedia.
